provider: Tencent Hunyuan text generation API (China site)
chaining: the page directs new model services to TokenHub; services already bought continue to work. TokenHub gives each main account a one-time free trial of 100 万 tokens for every language model, valid 1 year, in a campaign running to 2026-12-31, and its quick start also requires real-name authentication first. The international edition of TokenHub carries the same 100 万 tokens and is described in the chaining of the Tencent HY Text Generation Global record

free_tier.stated: A one-time free resource package on first activation: 共100万 tokens shared across Hunyuan-a13b, Hunyuan-role-latest, the translation models and the vision models, and a separate 100万 tokens for Hunyuan-embedding, each valid for 1 year from activation. The page states the functions are migrating to TokenHub and the original platform no longer accepts new model purchases

limits.value: 100万 tokens shared across the listed text and vision models, one-time; a separate 100万 tokens for Hunyuan-embedding
the package expires 1 year after activation and unused tokens become invalid

binding_note: real-name authentication gates activation before any quota applies

identity_cost.detail: activation needs Tencent Cloud enterprise or personal real-name authentication, quoted from the billing page. The vendor's account overview scopes China-site accounts to mainland enterprises and to individuals in the mainland, Hong Kong, Macao and Taiwan; whether a non-mainland passport completes China-site authentication is unverified

reliability_note: the page states the Hunyuan functions are migrating to TokenHub and the original platform stops supporting new model purchases
